concepts.title: Side-bow adventurer
concepts.detail: DESIGN A: shoulder-length chestnut brown hair with gently flipped ends, one large bubblegum-pink bow over her left temple. Pale pink cozy crewneck sweater with a small stitched yellow star on the chest, raspberry pleated skirt, lavender leggings, pink high-top sneakers. Sweet open smile, one hand resting lightly on her hip, other hand relaxed. Rounded friendly silhouette.
concepts.prompt: Create ONE new original full-body game character concept cutout for Z-God, the little sister of X God. The provided images are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY: match their homemade hand-drawn thick uneven black ink outlines, visible colored-pencil/crayon grain and lively readable side-scroller silhouettes. Do not copy the card layout or its text. Z-God is a cute ordinary six-year-old little girl with brown hair, warm brown eyes, rosy cheeks, and realistic age-appropriate child proportions adapted to this doodle cartoon world: large friendly head, short limbs, small child build, much shorter than the other heroes. She wears a pink sweater, a pink skirt, brown hair bows, opaque leggings and comfortable sneakers. She is secretly invincible and can defeat any enemy with one hit; communicate cheerful quiet confidence, not aggression or grown-up anatomy. Design must be suitable for later run/jump/attack sprite animation. Show the entire character including all hair, bows and both shoes, centered with generous transparent margins, standing in a relaxed lively three-quarter pose facing slightly right, hands visible and empty. No weapons, text, card, props, backdrop, ground or dramatic aura. Native transparent background. Polished game-ready hand-drawn concept, never a 3D render or vector-flat sticker. concepts.title: Pigtail powerhouse
concepts.detail: DESIGN B: medium brown twin low pigtails with two matching pink ribbon bows and soft bangs. Strawberry-pink cable-knit sweater, soft blush-pink flared skirt, cream leggings, chunky rose sneakers. Bright delighted grin, both hands loosely curled near her sides in an energetic ready-to-play stance. Small simple heart knit motif on sweater; ordinary cozy little-girl clothes.

concepts.title: Ponytail heroine
concepts.detail: DESIGN C: rich chocolate-brown high ponytail tied with an oversized dusty-rose bow, soft side bangs and loose strands. Oversized rose-pink sweater with ribbed cuffs and a tiny cream embroidered Z, mauve-pink layered skirt, deep plum opaque leggings, cream-and-pink sneakers. Gentle confident smile, a tiny friendly wave with one hand, the other relaxed. Make her visibly a small six-year-old child.
